brief:
Police in the Czech Republic have detained a group of pro-Palestine activists accused of an attack on a weapons factory, Al Jazeera English reported. The detained individuals claim the action was part of their advocacy efforts and allege authorities are intensifying pressure on the solidarity movement.

The activists dispute characterizations of their conduct as criminal and say law enforcement is attempting to suppress protest activity. They contend the crackdown extends beyond this single incident to target broader pro-Palestine organizing in the country.
dek: As a group is accused of an attack on a weapons factory, activists allege growing crackdown on the solidarity movement.
title: Czech authorities arrest pro-Palestine activists over weapons factory protest
